svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 90 long x 46 wide x 60 high; inner end 125 from the hub centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clevis slot 32 wide, from 25 in from the inner end to the outer end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot open below and above, except the stop bridge 10 x 10 across the top at the outer end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot hole 8.05 reamed, 14 up from the bottom, 55 from the inner end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock-pin hole 8.1, 37 up, 68 from the inner end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four M4 x 10 deep tapped holes top and bottom, 6 and 19 from the inner end, 15 either side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pocket 19 x 16 through between the bolt holes; side pockets 19 long x 11 deep, 16 to 44 up, each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 18 x 46 through both cheeks, 28 to 46 from the inner end, 7 to 53 up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cheeks cut away below 22 up from 65 to 78 from the inner end, and below 45 up from 78 to the outer end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave 4 to 5 walls round every hole; deburr; the bridge underside is flat: it carries the arm's lift

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an 8 mm pin slides through both pivot holes and both lock holes
